_provenance.source: CME Group contract-specification service, https://www.cmegroup.com/CmeWS/mvc/ContractSpecs/List/productId/{product_id}, read through each product's own contractSpecs.html page in a browser on 2026-09-10 (plain HTTP to cmegroup.com returns 403; the page's own XHR does not)
_provenance.why_not_hardcoded: docs/prop firm leads/02-data-acquisition-prompt.md validation gate 3: verify every multiplier from the exchange's own spec, do not hardcode from memory
_provenance.fields: contract_unit and min_tick are CME's wording verbatim (HTML stripped). usd_per_point, tick_points and tick_usd are parsed from them; scripts/fetch_futures_1m.py asserts usd_per_point * tick_points == tick_usd for every entry, and --validate asserts every bar's prices sit on the tick grid.
_provenance.note_on_hours: CME's wording differs in style between product groups (ET-first for equities, CT-first for energy/metals/rates) but every proposed symbol is on the same Globex template: open 18:00 ET Sunday, daily 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance break, close 17:00 ET Friday. The ags (ZC/ZS/ZW) are NOT on that template and BTC is 24/7 since 2026-05-30. The validator asserts the template from the bars, never from this file.
_provenance.not_verified_here: historical listing dates (micros May 2019, RTY on CME from 2017-07). Those are read from each symbol's first bar in the fixture.

second_fetch_2026_09_12.why: D488 and D491 could not cost GC, CL or 6E because their micros were absent, and D486 named the fetch as the highest-value unblock. Fetched the same way as the first pass: the product id from ProductSlate/V2/List, then ContractSpecs/List/productId/{id}, both read in a browser because plain HTTP to cmegroup.com returns 403.
second_fetch_2026_09_12.control: MNQ was re-fetched as a CONTROL and reproduced the committed values exactly ('0.25 index points = $0.50'), which is what licenses trusting the four new rows.
second_fetch_2026_09_12.derived_fields: usd_per_point is DERIVED as tick_usd / tick_points and cross-checked against the contract unit; every other field is transcribed. MGC and MCL were each verified to be exactly 1/10 of their committed parent (GC 100.0 and CL 1000.0 usd_per_point).
second_fetch_2026_09_12.tier_field_omitted: The existing rows carry a 'tier' field whose meaning is not documented here; it is omitted from the new rows rather than invented.

6E.name: Euro FX Futures
6E.VENUE_SPLIT_WARNING: CME publishes TWO minimum price fluctuations for this product and they differ by 5x: CME Globex 0.000050 = $6.25 (recorded above, and the one that applies to GLBX.MDP3 data) against CME ClearPort 0.000010 = $1.25. Taking the ClearPort tick would understate the tick value fivefold and overstate a cost-in-ticks figure by the same factor. No other product in this file carries such a split.

6E.listed: Quarterly contracts (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec) listed for 20 consecutive quarters and serial contracts listed for 16 months
